sn23.7:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
sn23.7:1.6: yato kho rādha, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayaṃ ca atthaṅgamaṃ ca assādaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn23.7:1.7: ayaṃ vuccati rādha, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
